تنتحرون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَحِرُونَ (tantaḥirūna) /tan.ta.ħi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# تُنْتَحَرُونَ (tuntaḥarūna) /tun.ta.ħa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
